title: Saxonberg Command Definition
description: YAML command spec consumed by CommandApi. Each .yaml file in this directory must validate against this schema.

verbs.description: Command verbs and aliases. The first entry is the primary verb.

controller.description: Class name of the CommandController to dispatch to. Optional only when every declared subcommand carries its own `controller:` (Option E — per-subcommand controller templates).

args.description: Positional args for the (flat) verb. Mutually exclusive with `subcommands`.

subcommands.description: Subcommand-keyed dispatch map. Mutually exclusive with `args`.

payload.description: Structured-form-only fields. Populated exclusively via CommandApi.assembleFromStructured — the text-input path doesn't surface these to the matcher. Same field shape as options (type / schema / scope / validators / multiple / default), minus the keyboard-focused fields (short / prepositions / greedy don't apply).

validators.description: Verb-level validators that fire BEFORE field validators with `context.commandGiver` populated. Used for command-shape preconditions (animacy, mobility, vocal capacity) that don't tie to a specific arg.

controller.description: Optional per-subcommand controller template name. When present, the framework clones THIS controller for the subcommand instead of the verb-level controller (Option E). Verbs whose subcommands all carry per-subcommand controllers may omit the verb-level `controller:` entirely.

name.description: Field name the bound value lands on. Reserved: `subcommand` (when the verb declares subcommands).

type.description: Field value type. `object` runs `MqlApi.resolveOne` (single-cardinality MQL); `objects` runs `MqlApi.resolveMany` (plural-cardinality MQL); `struct` is a structured-input-only blob (Record<string, unknown>) — text input cannot bind it.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema fragment validated against the structured value before user-defined validators fire. Only meaningful for `type: struct`. Runs through ajv during the structured-input coercion step.

greedy.description: Greedy positional: consumes the remainder of input verbatim. Must be the last arg in its array.

multiple.description: Accumulate multiple values into an array. Used for non-MQL fields; for MQL plural use `type: objects` instead.

default.description: Fill-in text used when the player provides no input for this field. Runs through ShellApi.expandVariables — `default: "$focus"` resolves to the giver's current focus at bind time.

scope.description: MQL fragment(s) the dispatcher tries when resolving this field. Each entry runs through ShellApi.expandVariables and is tried in order; first non-empty result wins. Array form is the explicit fallback chain (e.g. `['$focus', 'inventory, here']` for drill-first). Only meaningful for `type: object` / `type: objects`.

updates_focus.description: Focus management policy. `extend` appends the input fragment to the giver's current focus with `:` (with same-anchor compaction); `replace` re-anchors wholesale; `none` (default) leaves focus alone. Inspection-shaped verbs (look, examine, open, close) declare `extend`.

skip_focus_when_option.description: Name of a boolean option (or option-shaped model key) that, when truthy on the bound model, causes the dispatcher to SKIP the `updates_focus` step for this field. Pronoun-memory updates still fire — only the focus chain is held back. Canonical consumer: `look --peek` (renders prose without disturbing focus). Ignored when `updates_focus` is unset or `none`.

prepositions.description: Optional list of leading prepositions the matcher consumes (e.g. `[at]` for `look at`, `[to]` for `give X to Y`).

onExcess.description: Policy when MQL resolves more results than cardinality permits. See command-spec.md.

onShortage.description: Policy when MQL resolves fewer results than cardinality.min. v1 only value: 'error'.

cardinality.description: Authorial cardinality constraint on an `objects` field. Defaults to { min: 0, max: Infinity }. `exactly: N` is sugar for { min: N, max: N }.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema fragment validated against the structured value before user-defined validators fire. Only meaningful for `type: struct`.

scope.description: MQL fragment(s) the dispatcher tries when resolving this option's value. Same precedence + expander rules as a positional's `scope`. Only meaningful for `type: object` / `type: objects`.

field.description: Field name the bound value lands on. Defaults to the option's own name.

required.description: Used by payload fields (the structured-form-only family) to declare that the client MUST attach this key. Verb-scoped options ignore this — options are by convention optional.

validatorSpec.description: Validator path. Must start with `/` (mud-rooted absolute) or `./` / `../` (relative to YAML).
